plant.description: The slug of the plant the request acts at. Without it, the request acts at the company of its credential, and the server never picks a plant for the caller.
plant.name: plant

Retry-After.description: The seconds to wait before the credential may call again.

colorFrom.description: Where the color came from: erp, set by a person, or palette, the first free color at the group's create.

scope.description: Where the row sits: at the company, which every plant of it sees, or at the request's plant.

FieldError.description: One error of an input field.

code.description: The kind of issue, such as invalid_type or too_small.

message.description: What is wrong with the field, for a person to read.

path.description: The path to the field in the input.

Problem.description: An error of the public API (RFC 9457).

code.description: The module-scoped error code, such as core.version_conflict, which a client reads.

correlationId.description: The id that the server log records with the error.

detail.description: What went wrong, without internal details.

details.description: The values a client reads by code, such as the permission of core.forbidden.

errors.description: The field errors of the input; empty for none.

title.description: The fixed title of the status.

type.description: The documentation URI of the error code.

bearer.description: An integration token, which a Company admin creates under Settings, Integrations. It is bound to the company or one plant and acts with the roles it holds there. Each operation lists the permission it checks as its scope.

info.description: The public REST API of NorthMES for outside systems, such as an ERP. Writes are commands under /commands/, and every error is application/problem+json.
info.title: NorthMES API

post.description: Archives an article: lists hide it, it keeps its code, and it cannot be changed until it is restored. Needs core.article:archive.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

post.description: Archives an article group: lists hide it and no article can pick it, while the articles that have it keep it. Needs core.articleGroup:archive.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

post.description: Archives an equipment group: lists hide it, and it keeps its code. Needs core.equipmentGroup:archive where it sits; an archived equipment group is refused with core.archived.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

post.description: Creates an article of the company, assigned to the plants or to All plants that the input names, else to the request's plant. Needs core.article:create; a code that another article of the company uses is refused with core.code_taken.

allPlants.description: Assigns the article to every plant of the company, those created later included.

articleGroupId.description: The id of an active article group of the company; an empty value picks none.

code.description: The article number, unique within the company, at most 32 characters.

companyId.description: The company of a command sent from company settings, which names no plant. At a plant it may be left out, or must be the plant's company.

id.description: The id of the new entity, a UUID the client generates, so a retry finds the first.

name.description: The article's name, at most 200 characters.

note.description: A note on the article, at most 2000 characters; an empty note removes it.

plants.description: The slugs of the plants the article is assigned to. Without plants or allPlants, a new article is assigned to the request's plant.

stockUnit.description: The code of the unit the article's quantities are counted in. A new article without one counts in pieces.

translations.description: The translations of the name; an empty list removes them.

post.description: Creates an article group of the company. Needs core.articleGroup:create at the company; a code that another group of the company uses is refused with core.code_taken.

code.description: The group's code, unique within the company, at most 32 characters.

companyId.description: The company of a command sent from company settings, which names no plant. At a plant it may be left out, or must be the plant's company.

id.description: The id of the new entity, a UUID the client generates, so a retry finds the first.

name.description: The group's name, at most 200 characters.

translations.description: The translations of the name. An update that leaves them out keeps them.

post.description: Creates an equipment group at the company or at the request's plant. Needs core.equipmentGroup:create there; a code that another equipment group the scope sees uses is refused with core.code_taken.

code.description: The code, unique among the rows the scope sees, at most 32 characters.

color.description: The group's palette color. A create without one takes the first palette color that no group the request sees uses; an update without one keeps it.

companyId.description: The company of a command sent from company settings, which names no plant. At a plant it may be left out, or must be the plant's company.

id.description: The id of the new entity, a UUID the client generates, so a retry finds the first.

scope.description: Where the row sits: at the company, which every plant of it sees, or at the request's plant.

translations.description: The translations of the name. An update that leaves them out keeps them.

post.description: Restores an archived article, so lists show it and it can be changed again. Needs core.article:archive.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

post.description: Restores an archived article group. Needs core.articleGroup:archive; a group that is not archived is refused with core.not_archived.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

post.description: Restores an archived equipment group. Needs core.equipmentGroup:archive where it sits; one that is not archived is refused with core.not_archived.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

post.description: Replaces the plants of an article: a list of plants, All plants, or neither for an article that only company views show. Needs core.article:assign at the company.

allPlants.description: Assigns the article to every plant of the company, those created later included.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

plants.description: The slugs of the plants the article is assigned to; empty with allPlants.

post.description: Changes the code and name of an article, and its translations, stock unit, note and group when the input names them. Needs core.article:update; a code that another article uses is refused with core.code_taken.

articleGroupId.description: The id of an active article group of the company; an empty value picks none.

code.description: The article number, unique within the company, at most 32 characters.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

name.description: The article's name, at most 200 characters.

note.description: A note on the article, at most 2000 characters; an empty note removes it.

stockUnit.description: The code of the unit the article's quantities are counted in. A new article without one counts in pieces.

translations.description: The translations of the name; an empty list removes them.

post.description: Changes the code, name and translations of an article group. Needs core.articleGroup:update; an archived group is refused with core.archived.

code.description: The group's code, unique within the company, at most 32 characters.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

name.description: The group's name, at most 200 characters.

translations.description: The translations of the name. An update that leaves them out keeps them.

post.description: Changes an equipment group: its code, its name and the other fields the input sends. Needs core.equipmentGroup:update where it sits; an archived equipment group is refused with core.archived.

code.description: The code, unique among the rows the scope sees, at most 32 characters.

color.description: The group's palette color. A create without one takes the first palette color that no group the request sees uses; an update without one keeps it.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the entity that the change was made on; the command is refused when the entity has changed since.

id.description: The id of the entity the command changes.

translations.description: The translations of the name. An update that leaves them out keeps them.

post.description: Creates or changes the article with this article number in the company, for an ERP that pushes its articles. Needs core.article:create, and core.article:update or core.article:assign for the changes it makes to an existing article.

allPlants.description: Assigns the article to every plant of the company, those created later included.

articleGroupId.description: The id of an active article group of the company; an empty value picks none.

code.description: The article number, unique within the company, at most 32 characters.

companyId.description: The company of a command sent from company settings, which names no plant. At a plant it may be left out, or must be the plant's company.

expectedVersion.description: The version a change to an existing article was made on, else the version found.

id.description: The id of the article if the command creates it, a UUID the client generates.

name.description: The article's name, at most 200 characters.

note.description: A note on the article, at most 2000 characters; an empty note removes it.

plants.description: The slugs of the plants the article is assigned to. Without plants or allPlants, a new article is assigned to the request's plant.

source.description: The integration that sends the article, such as Pyramid. A new article keeps it as its source.

stockUnit.description: The code of the unit the article's quantities are counted in. A new article without one counts in pieces.

translations.description: The translations of the name; an empty list removes them.
